rca of the issue: RCA: The Login hero image references a hard-coded Unsplash URL via the HERO constant in Login.jsx (line 7). The proposed fix (point HERO to the local /bata-store.jpg and add data-testid) was never persisted to /app/frontend/src/pages/Login.jsx — the file on disk is unchanged. The asset exists at /app/frontend/public/bata-store.jpg and is served correctly (HTTP 200, image/jpeg). Reproduction: open /login → left panel shows Nike Air Jordan sneakers. Mitigation: edit Login.jsx line 7 to `const HERO = '/bata-store.jpg';` and add `data-testid="login-hero-image"` to the on line 26; hot-reload will apply.
